label: s2_sub_039_steel_02
text: You have my thanks for all you have done to help\nthe League Club...and to help Kieran.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_03
text: Once you became Champion, Kieran withdrew\nhimself entirely from our ranking system.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_04
text: Though I consider this somewhat sad, it is not as\nif he and I can no longer meet.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_05
text: More than anything, I am glad he seems to be\nacting like his former self once more.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_06
text: Indeed, I have been swept up in joy to such an\nextent that I prepared a tremendous amount of\r\nthe flight-enabling supplement used in my trial.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_12
text: Please feed your Agias an appropriate portion\nof it whenever you wish to fly.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_13
text: Wha—? You want to fly right now?\c\nPlease, slow down. The supplement was never\nmeant to be eaten in such large—[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_system_01
text: [VAR 0x0101(0001)] will be able to fly now!

label: s2_sub_039_steel_07
text: It would seem your Agias has...powered up\nsomehow.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_08
text: From the looks of it, I would guess that it has\ngained the power to fly whenever you wish it to.\c\nWell. I suppose this is an acceptable outcome...[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_09
text: As it happens, we just finished setting up a\n“super-hard” course for my Flying Time Trial.\c\nDo give it a try if you are confident in your skills.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_10
text:
As it happens, there is a “super-hard” course for
my Flying Time Trial.\c
You may attempt it upon clearing the hard
course. Feel free to do so when you are ready.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

label: s2_sub_039_steel_11
text: Time for me to go. So long, then.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]
